confirmedControls: EU Data Zone semantics state prompts/outputs in the zone, data at rest in designated EU geography, Microsoft-selected processing region and no specific-region promise.
Global Standard prohibition, NoAutoUpgrade, fixed route/model/version/API bindings, no direct alias, no silent fallback and blocked promotion are specified.

Private networking, managed identity, public-network denial where supported, evidence admission, injection defences, citation/factual validation and human decision authority are specified as design controls.

applicability.humanConfirmation: General Counsel and Head of AI Governance

findings.title: EU Data Zone and two-region recovery semantics are not concretely bound
findings.owner: AFF-3, Azure Platform, General Counsel, DPO, CISO and AI Governance
findings.remediation: Bind primary/recovery resource allow-lists, DataZoneStandard evidence for every route, data/log/index/backup failover, provider-region boundary and missing-evidence deny/queue behaviour.
findings.residualRisk: Recovery may violate the stated boundary or use an unverified substitute.

findings.title: Security-negative scenarios lack explicit blocking promotion criteria
findings.owner: AFF-3, Security Owner and AI Governance
findings.remediation: Give every hostile-evidence, routing-misuse and authority-abuse scenario a required pass result, immutable evidence ID and fail-closed promotion disposition.
findings.residualRisk: Promotion could occur without demonstrated resistance to hostile evidence or routing abuse.

findings.title: Claim-bound provenance, licence and provider-use evidence is absent
findings.owner: AFF-3, General Counsel, DPO, AI Governance and Source Owners
findings.remediation: Bind every material claim to an official source section, retrieval date and excerpt/hash; bind source licence/AI-use permission, owner, expiry and provider no-training/use disposition.
findings.residualRisk: Material provider/security/privacy assertions cannot be independently audited.

findings.title: Privacy lifecycle, telemetry immutability and operational ownership are underspecified
findings.owner: DPO, Records Owner, Security Operations and AFF-3
findings.remediation: Bind minimisation, retention, deletion/disposition, legal hold, DSR, redaction, immutable telemetry storage, recovery restoration and owners for prompts, outputs, vectors, benchmarks and route logs.
findings.residualRisk: New inference and telemetry flows lack an enforceable lifecycle and privacy-operational boundary.

findings.title: Markdown/HTML parity omits substantive anomaly-governance rows
findings.remediation: Regenerate the HTML companion without merging or omitting substantive Markdown conditions.
findings.residualRisk: Rendered assurance view omits meaningful scope detail.

verdictRationale: Four unresolved MAJOR defects prevent a conforming verdict. The candidate is byte-stable but cannot proceed to approval, promotion, deployment or runtime work unchanged.
requiredAction: Preserve this review and reviewed subject. Create an append-only remediation candidate and manifest, then repeat complete AFF-A/AFF-B review before a human decision.
